card.name: News-style article text near dates and sentence ends
card.fires_on: Sentence-ending periods, dates and numbers, and the word News in journal names, inside science and health news articles (Economist-style or Science News citations).

modes.label: Dates and numbers
modes.description: Digits or ordinal endings in dates and years within news prose.
modes.example: By June <<1>>5th American regulators are expected to approve

modes.label: Sentence ends in news
modes.description: Period closing a sentence about a new medical advance or a company.
modes.example: ANOTHER advance in the emerging technology of regenerative medicine has just been announced<<.>> It should soon be possible to make blood

modes.label: Citation words
modes.description: The word News in a journal name or an abbreviated month in a reference.

card.plain: It fires on dates, sentence ends and journal names in science news stories and citations.
